headline: Rough patch risk 33% in the next 7 days, driven by sleep
summary: Risk of a rough patch in the next 7 days: 33% (alert line 11%). The treatment calendar alone gives 2%; wearable signals move it +31 points. Biggest wearable driver: Sleep efficiency 62% vs usual 74%, waking 8.0x a night vs 1.0x, 7.7 h asleep vs 8.0 h.

profile.context: Day 14 of cycle 2 (IV chemo every 21 days)

evidence.label: Sleep
evidence.text: Sleep efficiency 62% vs usual 74%, waking 8.0x a night vs 1.0x, 7.7 h asleep vs 8.0 h

evidence.label: Steps
evidence.text: Steps 64% below their usual (476 vs 1,310 a day, last 3 days)

evidence.label: Watch wear
evidence.text: Watch off 2 of the last 7 days, worn 7 h/day vs usual 22 h

evidence.label: Check-ins
evidence.unit: daily check-ins skipped in a row
evidence.text: Skipped the last 3 daily check-ins. Across the program, people who come back after 3+ skips report a rough day 1.4x as often; today's wearable estimate: 94% chance today is rough (typical 6%)

evidence.label: Treatment calendar
evidence.text: Day 14 of cycle 2 (IV chemo every 21 days). The calendar alone predicts 2% risk of a rough patch this week.

recommendations.action: Check in this week about sleep: nights, naps, worries. Share the sleep tips sheet.
recommendations.why: Sleep got shorter or more broken than usual.
